verdict.rationale: Sentry's Alerts docs say an alert rule can 'call webhooks' when issues match pre-defined rules, so event-driven webhook delivery exists. The evidence only shows this as an action of alert rules, though, not as a general event-subscription mechanism. Missing for 10: a documented webhook subscription API or integration-level webhooks, a catalog of subscribable event types, payload schemas, signature verification and retry semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
